title: Claims Desk Tool Card: HostCover Theft Reimbursement
content:
A theft claim that the claims team has approved on a **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** plan is settled with a theft reimbursement. The figure booked is the theft reimbursement Roamhaven pays on that claim, and every base condition on paying a claim continues to apply: the claim is approved, it was escalated in time, the stay is covered, and a claim is reimbursed once.

## Capability

`pay_theft_reimbursement_c380c173` books the HostCover reimbursement Roamhaven pays the host on one approved theft claim. One call records a single reimbursement entry on the HostCover ledger of the plan the theft claim was filed under. The entry carries the claim, the stay the theft arose from, the loss the claims team verified on the claim, the date of the call and the reimbursement amount passed in. The plan's reimbursements grow by that amount, and the claim shows as reimbursed in the HostCover ledger from then on; the money is credited to the host's default payout method by the payout desk. The entry is visible at once in the HostCover ledger lookup for the claim.

## Invocation

This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `pay_theft_reimbursement_c380c173` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_id` | the reference number of the approved theft claim being reimbursed, as returned by the damage-claim lookup for the host's HostCover plan | identifier, as shown in the claim records |
| `amount` | the reimbursement Roamhaven pays on the claim | positive USD amount with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent; no currency symbol |

Neither parameter takes a fixed list of values.

## Return

On success the tool returns a receipt:

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| `status` | `reimbursement_booked` when the entry was written |
| `protection_event_id` | the reference number of the new ledger entry |
| `claim_id` | the theft claim reimbursed |
| `stay_id` | the stay the claim arose from |
| `amount` | the reimbursement booked in USD, 2 decimal places |
| `posted_date` | the booking date, YYYY-MM-DD |

## Illustration of a call (hypothetical values)

A call with `claim_id` set to a theft claim's reference number and `amount` set to 1250.40 returns `status` `reimbursement_booked`, a new `protection_event_id`, the same `claim_id`, the claim's `stay_id`, `amount` 1250.4 and the day's `posted_date`.
